statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent palpitations and intermittent dizziness
There is concern for symptomatic atrial fibrillation and sick sinus syndrome
The patient has known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) was ordered
The service was ordered to correlate episodic symptoms with underlying arrhythmias
The service was ordered to assess the efficacy of current rate control management
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial was based on lack of required precertification or authorization prior to the service date
